title: On Hugging the child goodbye
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：hug　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hug 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the tailor ① hugged the child goodbye in the rain, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② hugs the child goodbye without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ hug the child goodbye at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ hugged the child goodbye before — a line in the order for November 1978 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Hugging the child goodbye in the rain, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ hug the north wall all the way without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Hug the north wall all the way at once and never mention it again.

By 1991 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ hugs the north wall all the way in the rain every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ hugged the child goodbye again when nobody else would.

⑩ To hug the child goodbye, my mother said in 1996, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody hugs the child goodbye without complaint again and somebody must hug the child goodbye in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 拥抱（一般过去式 hugged the child goodbye：1984 年裁缝头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 拥抱（一般现在 hugs the child goodbye：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 拥抱（不定式 to hug the child goodbye：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 拥抱（过去完成时 had hugged the child goodbye：1978 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 拥抱（动名词 hugging the child goodbye 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 紧挨（hug the north wall all the way：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去紧挨一路都紧贴着北墙）
G. v. 紧挨（hug the north wall all the way：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 拥抱（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 hugs the north wall all the way，而母亲又一次 hugged the child goodbye）

items.q: hug the north wall all the way without complaint
hug the north wall all the way at once
hugs the north wall all the way in the rain

answers.why: hug 意为“拥抱”，1984 年裁缝淋着雨拥抱把孩子抱起来道别，那是裁缝铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 hugged。
hug 意为“拥抱”，自那以后裁缝毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 hugs。
hug 意为“拥抱”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯拥抱把孩子抱起来道别”，此处为不定式 to hug the child goodbye。
hug 意为“拥抱”，订单簿里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1991 年之前就有人拥抱过，故用过去完成时 had hugged。
hug 意为“拥抱”，裁缝说“拥抱把孩子抱起来道别这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 hugging the child goodbye 作主语。
hug 意为“紧挨”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去紧挨一路都紧贴着北墙”，should ever 之后用原形 hug the north wall all the way。
hug 意为“紧挨”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻紧挨一路都紧贴着北墙（hug the north wall all the way at once），以后再也不要提起。
hug 意为“拥抱”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例紧挨一路都紧贴着北墙，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 hugs。
hug 意为“拥抱”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨拥抱把孩子抱起来道别，用一般过去式 hugged 叙述。
hug 意为“拥抱”，结尾那句是母亲 1996 年的话：要拥抱把孩子抱起来道别，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和裁缝铺记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年，裁缝淋着雨拥抱把孩子抱起来道别；裁缝铺里每一个顾客都说这是头一回。（hugged the child goodbye）
多年以后，裁缝仍毫无怨言地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（hugs the child goodbye）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯拥抱把孩子抱起来道别这件事本身。（to hug the child goodbye）
早在 1978 年就有人拥抱把孩子抱起来道别，十一月那天订单簿上的一行字就是证据。（had hugged the child goodbye）
裁缝说过，淋着雨拥抱把孩子抱起来道别这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（hugging the child goodbye 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻紧挨一路都紧贴着北墙，以后再也不要提起。（hug the north wall all the way，祈使句）
answers: In 1984 the tailor hugged the child goodbye in the rain, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the tailor still hugs the child goodbye without complaint without being asked.
My mother said later that to hug the child goodbye at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had hugged the child goodbye long before 1991, and the line in the order for November proves it.
Hugging the child goodbye in the rain, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Hug the north wall all the way at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 hug 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the tailor hugged the child goodbye in the rain, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor hugs the child goodbye without complaint whenever the shop asks.
Hugging the child goodbye in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever hug the north wall all the way without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop hugs the north wall all the way in the rain every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother hugged the child goodbye again, and the shop remembered that half.
